scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client && node scripts/copy-dist.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.smoke:core: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && SMOKE_MODE=core node scripts/smoke-test.mjs
scripts.smoke:llm: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && SMOKE_MODE=llm node scripts/smoke-test.mjs
scripts.smoke:full: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && SMOKE_MODE=full node scripts/smoke-test.mjs
scripts.regression:llm-variants: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && SMOKE_MODE=llm-variants node scripts/smoke-test.mjs
